subject.title: feat: cross-gateway sessions_send and sessions_spawn via gateway.peers

question: Should OpenClaw core accept operator-configured cross-gateway peers for session tools now, and should raw per-call `gatewayUrl` overrides remain prohibited for agent tools?
rationale: The PR creates a new credentialed cross-gateway session and message-delivery boundary, while the current agent-tool URL guard intentionally restricts model-visible gateway redirects.

options.title: Approve a configured-peer-only path
options.body: Keep raw `gatewayUrl` behind the existing agent-tool allowlist, require a clear peer credential story, and repair this PR around operator-configured peers plus live proof.

options.title: Pause for federation design
options.body: Use the open federation and cross-gateway issues to define identity, scopes, replay, transcript ownership, and delivery semantics before accepting code.

options.title: Allow arbitrary per-call URLs
options.body: Explicitly bless the larger model-visible URL surface, but require security docs, tests, and operator warnings before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve a configured-peer-only path
recommendation.body: Keep raw `gatewayUrl` behind the existing agent-tool allowlist, require a clear peer credential story, and repair this PR around operator-configured peers plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for session/gateway/security contract direction points to Peter Steinberger's adjacent work.
